description: Review all performance display modes, captured pixels and reversible F3/menu toggles on a rendered game.
prerequisites: Disposable save/settings fixture and visible rendered game
Do not force MHP3RD_PERF: mode selection must remain editable
Follow tests/manual/settings_menu.md; retain a separate original-scene capture

review.expect: Overlay and Overlay and Log retain the full top-left display. Off and Log Only leave the game picture free of the overlay.
Compact occupies one padded line at the bottom-left content inset, with readable FPS, speed and actual Vsync state. The old top-left rectangle stays clear.
Compact and Log emits full performance summaries; Compact alone emits none after the mode change has taken effect. Compare timestamped log intervals, not accumulated startup history.

F3 hides/restores the selected style without changing its saved mode or log choice; repeated key-down events do not toggle twice. Without a keyboard, record F3 as unavailable and separately test menu Off/Compact round trips.
Frame/window captures agree on placement and Vsync indication at native and one larger target; aspect/resize changes leave the scene and inset intact.
Restarting the exact artifact restores the selected copied-settings mode. Report display timing and frame-rate behavior separately from overlay correctness.
